cleanup.description: By default, Lotrex removes empty directories during deployment only when a game or related tool would otherwise fail. Empty directories are usually harmless, and removing them makes deployment take longer. Enable this workaround only if empty directories cause a problem, and report the affected game or tool so the behavior can be improved.
